**Fleet Compliance Engineer**

**ScottishPower HQ, Glasgow (hybrid)**

**Salary up to £43,500 \+ excellent benefits**

**Full\-time, permanent position (happy to talk flexible working)**

**Closing date – Monday 12th of October**

  

**Help us create a better future, quicker!**

The Fleet Compliance Engineer will assist the Lead Operations Manager in the control of all vehicle risks in relation to ScottishPower delivering its Operator Licence statutory requirements as set out by the DVSA.

  

The Fleet Compliance Engineer is responsible for ensuring the roadworthiness of ScottishPower’s fleet of 1,500 vehicles including but not limited to vehicle inspection, maintenance record auditing, vehicle and driver safety, monitoring of contracted service delivery standards (and challenging such standards when required), vehicle environmental condition, and Operator License processes adherence and compliance.

  

**What you’ll be doing**

* Support the implementation of the Fleet HS\&E controls across the ScottishPower Businesses, including a UK wide fleet compliance audit programme
* Implement audit practices to demonstrate vehicle record compliance in line with Operator License and statutory obligations
* Inspect vehicles (HGV and LCV) in the field to ensure that maintenance activities have been professionally, safely, and competently undertaken
* Escalate areas of concern, defects, etc to the Lead Operations Manager, Senior Managers, and external supply chain partners
* Identify immediate safety and/or compliance issues and, if required, prohibiting the use of a vehicle; confidently communicating such prohibition to the customer and standing behind the decision
* Develop an escalation process to enable effective management information reporting that identifies major fleet risk elements and trends with risk indicators across the group
* Develop relationships with internal ScottishPower customers in order to educate drivers in their responsibility in reducing vehicle and compliance risk
* Work closely with drivers to embed auditable processes and policies to ensure vehicles are legal and roadworthy in line with the Traffic Commissioners “Guide to Maintaining Roadworthiness”
* Support the management of outsourced service providers by assisting towards continuous improvement across all areas of service delivery to ensure all statutory, contractual, commercial and performance objectives are fully satisfied
  

**What you’ll bring**

* Experience of managing vehicle compliance for a commercial fleet
* Experience in vehicle risk management processes and policy information
* Experienced in health, safety, and environmental management, with the ability to respond to H\&S risks and or fleet emergency response
* Proven ability to build credibility, independently and constructively challenge the driver population towards best practice in line with General Services Fleet policy
* Ability to influence and encourage behavioural change
* Ability to assess, prioritise and confidently make the right decision in a dynamic service environment
* Good report writing skills with the ability to analyse data
* Ideally you will be working towards a certificate of Professional Competence for Transport Management
* NEBOSH is highly desirable
  

**Minimum Criteria**

* Experience of managing vehicle compliance for a commercial fleet
* Operator Licence Awareness (for example, Logistics UK eOLAT)
* Technically qualified in motor vehicle maintenance and repair or equivalent experience
* Good understanding of health, safety and environmental parameters impacting Fleet management services
* Strong communications skills
  

**Special Requirements**

* Flexibility to work out\-with normal working hours in response to vehicle compliance checking and user responsibilities
* Flexibility to work in locations out\-with normal working location
* Must hold a UK Drivers License
  

**What’s in it for you**


As well as a competitive salary which is reviewed annually, you can also enjoy a number of other benefits. With our pension scheme, we’ll double match your contribution up to a company contribution of 10%.  



At ScottishPower, we believe it’s the little things we do in life that make a big difference. That’s why our benefits include:


* 36 days annual leave
* Holiday Purchase – perfect your work/life balance with extra annual leave

* Payroll Giving and Charity Matched Funding
* Technology Vouchers – save more and spread the cost of your technology purchases
* Electric Vehicle Schemes – to help you transition to green/clean driving
* Cycle to Work scheme and Public Transport Season Ticket Loans
* Healthcare benefit options including: Dental Insurance, Private Medical Insurance, Health Cash Plan and annual Health Assessments
* Life Assurance (4x salary)
* Access to Savesmart financial wellbeing support
* Plus shopping, leisure, restaurant and gym discounts, and unique employee deals on travel insurance and more
  

**Why ScottishPower**


ScottishPower is part of the Iberdrola Group, one of the world’s largest integrated utility companies and a world leader in wind energy. With a commitment to generate all of our energy from renewable resources and a drive to create the energy infrastructure of the future, we’re at the forefront of the journey to Net Zero and investing over £6m every working day to make this happen. With diverse opportunities across our businesses and a commitment to invest in our own internal talent, ScottishPower can offer people real career opportunities that meet personal and professional goals, in a global organisation.

  

Inclusion, diversity, and a social purpose are at the heart of everything we do. Together with our values, they bring us together into a stronger, more sustainable business with direct links to the communities we serve. **Title:** Platform Engineer

**Location:** Cambridge, UK

 **Join Our Visionary Team:**


OLI's growing organization is at the center of our mission to make complex chemistry computable, accessible, and actionable. Our teams build the scientific software and infrastructure that enable engineers across energy, water treatment, critical materials, and other industries to solve complex problems with confidence.


As more of OLI's products and customer experiences move to the cloud, the reliability and scalability of the infrastructure behind them become increasingly important. We are looking for a Platform Engineer to help build, operate, automate, and support the cloud foundation for OLI's next generation of products.

**Your Role:**


As a Platform Engineer, you will be a hands\-on member of the team responsible for OLI's cloud infrastructure. You will help build and support our Azure environment for OLI's next\-generation platform.


This role is ideal for a mid\-level engineer looking to grow. You'll work within established platform architecture and engineering standards to implement infrastructure as code, support CI/CD pipelines, monitor production systems, troubleshoot deployment and performance issues, and strengthen automation across our cloud environments. As you build experience, your ownership will grow with it, from taking on larger pieces of the platform and leading incident response to helping shape the standards you started out following.


You will collaborate closely with senior platform, software, and process systems engineers. This is a strong opportunity for an engineer who wants to deepen their cloud, DevOps, and reliability expertise while contributing directly to a customer\-facing SaaS platform. We see platform work as software engineering: much of what you build will be code that other engineers depend on.

**About OLI:**


OLI is the global standard for electrolyte chemistry simulation, with over 50 years of peer\-reviewed science embedded in its platform. More than 500 enterprises and academic institutions across 35\+ countries rely on OLI software to make confident, defensible engineering decisions \- from predicting scale formation and modeling corrosion to optimizing water chemistry and complex industrial processes.

**Why You're Vital to Our Mission:**


As client usage of OLI's cloud\-based offerings grows, we need infrastructure that is reliable, secure, observable, and increasingly automated. Your work will help us strengthen the Azure foundation for our next\-generation platform and reduce operational burden through better tooling and automation.


By improving deployment reliability, infrastructure consistency, monitoring, and support, you will directly contribute to customer experience, engineering velocity, and OLI's ability to scale its cloud platform.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build, configure, maintain, and support cloud infrastructure in Microsoft Azure.
* Implement and maintain infrastructure as code in Terraform, following established OLI patterns.
* Build and maintain internal tooling, reusable infrastructure modules, and Helm charts that help the wider engineering team ship consistently.
* Build, support, and improve CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps to enable consistent, secure, and reliable software releases.
* Deploy and support containerized workloads using Docker, Kubernetes (AKS), and related tooling.
* Monitor infrastructure and application health, investigate alerts, and troubleshoot deployment, availability, capacity, and performance issues.
* Help improve observability through logging, monitoring, tracing, dashboards, and alerting using tools such as Azure Application Insights and Grafana.
* Support incident response and contribute to runbooks, post\-incident improvements, and automation that reduces repeat issues.
* Apply established security and compliance controls across cloud environments, including access management, secrets handling, and SOC 2 practices.
* Partner with software engineers and process systems engineers to support cloud deployments and resolve infrastructure\-related development issues.
* Document infrastructure configurations, deployment procedures, troubleshooting steps, and operational standards.
* Use AI\-assisted engineering tools appropriately to accelerate coding, troubleshooting, documentation, and delivery while maintaining security and code quality.
* Participate in appropriate out\-of\-hours support (on\-call) for critical platform issues.

  

**Requirements**  

We are looking for a practical, curious engineer who enjoys building reliable systems and learning how the pieces of a cloud platform fit together. You should be comfortable working hands\-on, asking questions, following established engineering patterns, and taking ownership of assigned infrastructure and operational problems through resolution.

* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in platform engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), cloud engineering, or a related infrastructure\-focused role.
* Hands\-on experience building, deploying, maintaining, or supporting production cloud infrastructure.
* Practical experience with Azure compute, networking, identity, and CI/CD (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions).
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code principles and tooling.
* Working knowledge of Docker and containerized application environments, and hands\-on experience deploying, operating, and debugging Kubernetes workloads, not just authoring manifests.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, troubleshooting, and core cloud security concepts in production environments.
* Ability to write maintainable code beyond one\-off scripts, such as infrastructure modules, internal tools, or automation that other engineers rely on, using a language such as C\#, Python, or TypeScript.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with engineers across disciplines.
* BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with relevant Azure services such as AKS, API Management, Key Vault, and Application Insights.
* Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines and building reusable Terraform modules for Infrastructure as Code.
* Hands\-on experience with Helm charts.
* Exposure to SOC 2 Type II controls or similar security and compliance frameworks.
* Familiarity with authentication and identity tools such as Auth0 or Entra ID.
* Experience supporting public APIs, SaaS applications, or other customer\-facing cloud services.
* Familiarity with AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or ChatGPT.

  

**Benefits**  

* A chance to be part of a visionary company solving complex global challenges.
* Hands\-on experience with the cloud infrastructure behind scientific software used by customers around the world.
* The opportunity to grow your expertise across Azure, Kubernetes, automation, security, and platform reliability.
* Competitive compensation, including incentives and bonuses based on performance.
* Opportunities for personal and professional growth.

***Equal Opportunity Employer***

*OLI is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all.*

*Applicants will be evaluated through a structured, rubric\-based interview process to ensure consistency and fairness. OLI supports equitable career progression. Advancement decisions are guided by consistent evaluation criteria and regular performance conversations.*

The primary focus of this role is AI security assurance: implementing and operating Moonshot and Litmus testing, conducting adversarial and risk\-based assessments of LLM and agentic applications, translating compliance requirements into practical controls, and advising internal stakeholders on secure data handling and solution architecture. Software test automation remains an important secondary responsibility to support reliable product delivery.


This role suits an engineer who can combine hands\-on security testing with sound architectural judgement, communicate risk clearly, and work collaboratively with product, engineering, security, governance, and business teams.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**AI Security, Compliance \& Architecture** **:**

* **AI Security Testing:** Design and execute AI\-specific security and safety assessments for LLM, RAG, and agentic applications, covering threats such as prompt injection, jailbreaks, sensitive\-data disclosure, insecure output handling, excessive agency, tool misuse, and cross\-tenant data exposure. Conventional application penetration testing is performed by third\-party providers and is outside the primary scope of this role.
* **Moonshot \& Litmus Implementation:** Implement and operationalise Moonshot and Litmus testing across relevant AI use cases. Configure baseline and application\-specific test suites, curate adversarial scenarios, analyse results, and establish repeatable evidence for assurance reviews.
* **AI Evaluation \& Test Data Governance:** Develop representative test datasets and securely generate synthetic data for functional, safety, and security evaluation. Ensure test data is appropriately classified, masked, anonymised, retained, and disposed of in accordance with applicable policies.
* **Compliance, Assurance \& Risk Advisory:** Translate organisational policies, government security requirements, and AI governance expectations into testable controls and evidence. Advise internal stakeholders on secure use of enterprise and sensitive data in GenAI solutions, including data flows, access controls, tenant isolation, retrieval boundaries, logging, retention, model or service selection, and third\-party integration risks. Support risk assessments, security reviews, audit responses, remediation plans, and go\-live assurance activities.
* **Secure Solution Architecture:** Review proposed AI solution designs, identify security and privacy risks, recommend proportionate controls, and collaborate with engineering and architecture teams to embed security by design throughout the solution lifecycle.
* **Security Findings, Remediation \& Reporting:** Document vulnerabilities and control gaps with clear risk, impact, evidence, and remediation guidance. Work with delivery teams to track and validate fixes, communicate residual risk to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, and report assurance metrics, recurring findings, and risk trends.
* **Security Automation \& Release Assurance:** Integrate automated AI security and evaluation tests into CI/CD pipelines and release processes. Define security regression checks, release gates, and acceptance criteria to identify material risks before production deployment.
  

**Software Test Automation** **:**

* **Test Automation:** Build and maintain automated functional, regression, API, and end\-to\-end tests using suitable frameworks such as Pytest, Playwright, Cypress, or Postman.
* **Defect Investigation:** Reproduce issues, trace application and cloud logs, isolate root causes, and provide actionable defect reports to engineering teams.
* **Quality Enablement:** Promote pragmatic testing practices, reusable test assets, and shared ownership of quality across product and engineering teams.

* **Experience:** 3\+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, cybersecurity, application security, AI assurance, SDET, or technical QA automation.
* **AI Security Knowledge:** Practical understanding of security and safety risks affecting LLM, RAG, and agentic applications, including prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool use, excessive permissions, insecure output handling, and model or application abuse.

Dit ga je doen

Als Azure cloud engineer werk je niet aan één afgebakend stukje, maar aan het platform als geheel – de motor onder de oplossingen die onze workloadteams voor de Rechtspraak bouwen. Dat betekent: schakelen tussen networking, security, compliance, policies en platformstandaarden. Alles wat we doen, leggen we vanaf de basis vast in infrastructure as code met Bicep, Azure Verified Modules en Azure DevOps. Automatisering is daarbij geen extra stap, maar de standaard manier van werken. Je gaat volop de breedte in, zonder technisch aan de oppervlakte te blijven.

Je ziet hoe keuzes op platformniveau doorwerken in de praktijk. Loopt een workloadteam vast bij de inrichting van een Azure-omgeving, dan kom jij in beeld. Bijvoorbeeld als identities niet goed zijn geconfigureerd, netwerkverkeer vastloopt, of een security-policy iets blokkeert terwijl alles op papier klopt. Jij duikt erin: waar zit het probleem, welke instelling staat in de weg, en hoe los je dat zo op dat niet alleen dit team verder kan, maar het hele platform sterker wordt?

Je kijkt verder dan de eerste oplossing. Zie je dat iets slimmer, veiliger of beter schaalbaar kan volgens het CAF? Dan breng je dat in en vertaal je het naar platformverbeteringen die je direct herbruikbaar, beheersbaar en geautomatiseerd vastlegt. Zo bouw je mee aan een platform dat compliant, veilig en schaalbaar is, en waar workloadteams op kunnen vertrouwen.

Wil je meer zijn dan de engineer die alleen uitvoert wat al bedacht is? Houd je van korte lijnen en veel eigen inbreng? En wil je Azure inzetten op een plek waar technische keuzes er echt toe doen? Dan is dit misschien jouw volgende stap.

Dit krijg je

Arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op onbepaalde tijd
1 jaar
32 - 36 uur

Dit bieden we nog meer

Om te beginnen een leuke, informele werksfeer. We houden de lijnen graag kort! En je arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn prima geregeld volgens de CAO Rijk. Wat belangrijke punten op een rij:

Contract: een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 36 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
Salaris: je komt terecht in salarisschaal 10 of 11 (maximaal € 6.275,94 per maand bij een werkweek van 36 uur). Inschaling vindt plaats op basis van je werkervaring.
